reproducibility_gaps: The provider landing verifies the dataset and exposes representative files, but the complete 16-experiment file manifest, item version, checksums and any per-file licence exceptions were not independently normalized.
The paper identifies H1 and H4 and documents acquisition and PINN ingestion, but the exact repository-variable schema and complete preprocessing/file mapping remain independently unresolved.
The MATLAB release, toolboxes, entrypoint files and dependency versions for the deposited energetics code are not specified in the bounded provider metadata.
No dataset, README or MATLAB payload was opened and no analysis or PINN workflow was executed.
notes: R2 reflects a stable DOI, verified provider record, explicit dataset licence, verified data availability, usage documentation and a primary-paper mapping to H1/H4.
R3 is withheld because the complete versioned/checksummed manifest, exact data schema/preprocessing map and MATLAB environment/entrypoints are not independently pinned.
